Synthetic Alabama Pre-K sample sites

Source: R/data-docs.R
cacs_alabama_sites.Rd

A small, ready-to-use sf POINT layer of 10 anonymous Alabama locations, supplied as example input for cacs_run() and the worked examples throughout the documentation and vignettes. It lets you exercise the full catchment pipeline without preparing your own site file.

Coordinates are synthetic: they are derived from public Alabama city centroids and then perturbed with a small reproducible random jitter (about 0.007 degrees, roughly 0.5 mile, per axis). This preserves the rough statewide geographic spread of Pre-K activity while ensuring no point corresponds to a real facility. These are not actual First Class Pre-K facility locations and contain no administrative records.

Usage

data("cacs_alabama_sites")

Format

An sf POINT object with 10 rows and 4 attribute columns plus a geometry column. The coordinate reference system is geographic WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

site_id

Character. Anonymous site identifier, "AL_SITE_01" through "AL_SITE_10".

site_name

Character. Anonymous site label, "Sample Site 1" through "Sample Site 10".

county_fips

Character. 5-digit county FIPS code of the anchor city.

region_label

Character. Coarse Alabama regional grouping (e.g. "Birmingham Metro", "North").

geometry

sfc_POINT geometry in EPSG:4326.

Source

Synthetic coordinates derived from public Alabama city centroids (U.S. Census Bureau Gazetteer / GNIS) and perturbed with a reproducible uniform jitter. The points are placeholders for demonstration only and do not represent any real facility.

Examples

data("cacs_alabama_sites")
print(cacs_alabama_sites)
#> Simple feature collection with 10 features and 4 fields
#> Geometry type: POINT
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: -88.0382 ymin: 30.68891 xmax: -85.38495 ymax: 34.79879
#> Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
#>       site_id      site_name county_fips     region_label
#> 1  AL_SITE_01  Sample Site 1       01073 Birmingham Metro
#> 2  AL_SITE_02  Sample Site 2       01097      South Coast
#> 3  AL_SITE_03  Sample Site 3       01089            North
#> 4  AL_SITE_04  Sample Site 4       01101          Central
#> 5  AL_SITE_05  Sample Site 5       01125     West Central
#> 6  AL_SITE_06  Sample Site 6       01081     East Central
#> 7  AL_SITE_07  Sample Site 7       01103    North Central
#> 8  AL_SITE_08  Sample Site 8       01077        Northwest
#> 9  AL_SITE_09  Sample Site 9       01069        Southeast
#> 10 AL_SITE_10 Sample Site 10       01055        Northeast
#>                      geometry
#> 1  POINT (-86.80902 33.52203)
#> 2   POINT (-88.0382 30.68891)
#> 3    POINT (-86.588 34.73295)
#> 4   POINT (-86.2999 32.36788)
#> 5  POINT (-87.56317 33.20985)
#> 6   POINT (-85.4865 32.61439)
#> 7  POINT (-86.98385 34.60084)
#> 8  POINT (-87.67252 34.79879)
#> 9  POINT (-85.38495 31.22738)
#> 10 POINT (-85.99976 34.02062)
nrow(cacs_alabama_sites)               # 10
#> [1] 10
sf::st_crs(cacs_alabama_sites)$epsg    # 4326
#> [1] 4326

# Run the catchmentACS pipeline (requires network + routing provider)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
result <- cacs_run(
  sites         = cacs_alabama_sites[1:3, ],
  state         = "AL",
  year          = 2023,
  drive_times   = c(5, 10, 15),
  variables     = "core",
  provider      = "osrm",
  weight_method = "area",
  output        = "long",
  verbose       = FALSE
)
head(result)
} # }
